resources.string: OsmAnd is not installed. This app works with the official OsmAnd and does nothing without it.
Lost the connection to OsmAnd (it may have been closed). Tap “Sync now” to reconnect.
The installed OsmAnd does not support the connection interface (AIDL). Update OsmAnd from Google Play.
These points are sent straight to the OsmAnd map. They stay visible while OsmAnd is running and are re-sent automatically when you open this app.
This server has no point layers.

Image layers reach OsmAnd only through the settings package (.osf), because the connection interface cannot select overlays. After importing: Configure map → Overlay map, then pick the layer. The “Online maps” plugin must be enabled in OsmAnd.
OsmAnd shows its import screen so you confirm it yourself.
Streets, names and 3D buildings come from OsmAnd’s own maps (download the Syria map inside OsmAnd). Verified traffic and safety notices are not shown in the app yet.
Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and the server address.
Not connected to OsmAnd. Open OsmAnd once, then tap “Sync now”.
This OsmAnd version does not support this feature. Update OsmAnd.
OsmAnd refused the request because Syria Maps is not enabled there yet. Tap “Allow”, or open OsmAnd: Menu → Plugins and switch on “Syria Maps” in the list.
Could not download the package from the server.
This OsmAnd version has no permission screen. Enable Syria Maps by hand: open OsmAnd → Menu → Plugins, switch on “Syria Maps” in the list and come back here.
Syrian layers right on the OsmAnd map
Enter your server address (https) in the “Server” section below.
You can change it later with the gear button.
Light in yellow, dark in black, or follow the phone.
The address of the Syria Maps server the layers come from.
Cannot reach the server. Check the address and connection.
The current address is only an example. Enter your server, or continue and change it later.
Syria Maps adds its layers to the official OsmAnd.
Only once: open OsmAnd → Menu → Plugins and switch on “Syria Maps” in the list. Otherwise OsmAnd refuses the points.
Switch on the layers you want – they appear right away on the OsmAnd map.
Wrong street name? A school missing from the map? Send a note to OpenStreetMap – volunteers fix it, and the fix reaches everyone\'s OsmAnd maps.
Report a problem or add a place
Test build: sends to the OSM test server
From a Syria Maps point in OsmAnd
No location found. Turn on location, or pick the place in OsmAnd.
Best: in OsmAnd long-press the place → Share → Syria Maps. That way your own location is not sent.
The note is public: everyone can see it on OpenStreetMap with its location and text, but not your name. Do not enter personal data, and do not report military or security sites.
I understand the note is public
OpenStreetMap volunteers will see it and fix the map after checking. The fix reaches OsmAnd with the next map update.
Could not send. Check your internet connection and try again.
Tap to open the report in Syria Maps
Syria Maps points in OsmAnd get a report button. Needs the notification permission, because Android does not let apps open themselves from the background.
Public note for volunteers, reaches the OsmAnd maps
A moderator reviews it; appears in “Community places”

Goes to the Syria Maps server and is reviewed by a moderator before publishing. Your name and IP address are not stored. Accepted new places are published under CC0 (free for everyone). Do not enter personal data, and do not report military or security sites.
I agree to publish under CC0
Send to the Syria Maps team
A moderator will review it. If the new place is accepted, it appears in the “Community places” layer in the app and in OsmAnd.
Too many reports in a short time. Please try again in an hour.
With your OSM account: add a place or fix a name right away
You need a free OpenStreetMap account. You enter the password only on openstreetmap.org; this app never sees it.
Waiting for the login in the browser…
Login did not complete. Please try again.
Your login expired. Please log in again.
Could not load nearby OpenStreetMap data.
No named places or streets near this location.
For closed places and other problems, please send an OpenStreetMap note so someone checks on the ground before anything is deleted.
The change is public right away, under your OSM account and the ODbL. Only edit what you know on the ground, and never copy from Google Maps or other maps.
I know this place on the ground
Someone else just edited this place. Please search again and retry.
Your change is live on OpenStreetMap and reaches the OsmAnd maps with the next update.
